No café e no mercado: At the café and the market
Pedir algo, perguntar o preço, contar de: Order something, ask the price, count from 1 to 10, by tens up to 50 and say 100, and close the first cycle of lessons.
Depois de 1 usa-se «рубль»; depois de 2,: After 1 you use «рубль»; after 2, 3 and 4, «рубля»; after 5 or more, «рублей». Learn the three forms as a pattern (English only needs «ruble/rubles»). «Один» has a feminine form («одна») and a neuter one («одно»); «два» becomes «две» with feminine words («две книги»).
Count from 1 to 10 aloud twice. Then say: «Это стоит пять рублей.»

«Я хочу» = eu quero (com um objeto ou um: «Я хочу» = I want (with an object or a verb in the infinitive). «Дайте, пожалуйста» = give me, please: the polite form, for someone you address as «вы». The verb «хотеть» is irregular: хочу, хочешь, хочет, хотим, хотите, хотят.
Diga: «Я хочу кофе. Дайте, пожалуйста, в: Say: «Я хочу кофе. Дайте, пожалуйста, воду. Сколько стоит?»

No café e na loja: At the café and in the shop
— Hello! I would like a coffee and some bread, please.
— Sim, é tudo. Quanto custa?: — Yes, that is all. How much is it?
— O café custa cem rublos, o pão, cinque: — The coffee costs one hundred rubles, the bread, fifty.
— One hundred and fifty rubles. Here you are.
Esta é uma loja. Aqui há pão, leite e ág: This is a shop. Here there is bread, milk and water. The bread costs fifty rubles, the milk costs fifty rubles and the water costs thirty rubles. I want bread and milk. That is one hundred rubles.
